name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 8 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 54 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2026-01-02, at wavelengths from 0.91 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
